stories.text: Gilbane Federal won a $114M Coast Guard job to rebuild Base Kodiak's water system, including more than eight miles of new main.
Input costs held steady in October but sit 11.5% above last year, with steel mill products up about a third.
A Supreme Court stay restarts roughly $7.5B in Big Bend border contracts held by Kiewit, Barnard and others, pending a final ruling.
Leica Geosystems launched the DMC-5 aerial mapping camera, which it says gathers over 30% more imagery per flight than earlier models.
The UK's Dstl is seeking industry input on a timing and positioning system that keeps working when GNSS is jammed or degraded.
Taoglas released an off-the-shelf reference design for anti-jam CRPA antennas, aimed at speeding up resilient GNSS product development.
Freeport-McMoRan will pay about US$77M for 51% of TDG Gold's Aurora West copper project in BC's Toodoggone district.
Paladin Energy is raising A$525M to build its Patterson Lake South uranium mine in Saskatchewan, targeting first output in 2031.
Mineros spent US$137M stockpiling gold bullion last quarter, and one analyst warns the strategy adds margin-call and cash risks.
